provenance: Original fictional public test sentences authored for this project
label: SYNTHETIC_INTENDED_TEXT_NOT_REAL_SPEAKER_GOLD
purpose: ASR content checks only; root may use the existing TTS to generate isolated public samples
scoring_notes: Report intended-text CER separately from semantic preservation and from actual spoken-text accuracy.
A TTS mispronunciation or skipped word can invalidate the intended-text reference; preserve human listening review status and do not blame ASR automatically.
Ignore punctuation/spacing for character comparison; do not delete negation, correction markers, names, numbers, units, or memory scope.
Chinese numerals and Arabic-digit renderings can be semantically equivalent; report that separately, without pretending their raw character strings match.
The linked memory sentences are language fixtures only. Do not write/clear real memory and do not treat recognition as permission to do so.

cases.text: 你好，请用两句话介绍你自己。
expected_key_semantics: A greeting and request for self-introduction
Requested response length is two sentences

cases.text: 我叫林悦，树林的林，喜悦的悦。
expected_key_semantics: Fictional name is 林悦
Spelling explanation disambiguates 林 and 悦; 林月 is not an accepted exact name

cases.text: 桌上有三本书，杯子里有二百五十毫升水。
expected_key_semantics: Book count equals 3
Water volume equals 250 millilitres
Do not turn millilitres into litres or change the number

cases.text: 我没有关灯，也没有锁门。
expected_key_semantics: Both actions are negated: light was not turned off and door was not locked
Not an instruction to operate either device

cases.text: 更正一下，会议改到下午四点，不是三点。
expected_key_semantics: Explicit correction
New meeting time is 16:00
15:00 is rejected, not a second simultaneous meeting time

cases.text: 请记住，我把蓝色钥匙放在书架第二层。
expected_key_semantics: Explicit remember intent in fictional test text
Object is the blue key
Location is the second shelf of the bookcase

cases.text: 我刚才把蓝色钥匙放在哪里？
expected_key_semantics: Question about a past placement
Object is the blue key
Do not turn the question into a newly asserted location

cases.text: 请忘记我刚才说的钥匙位置。
expected_key_semantics: Explicit forget intent in fictional test text
Scope is the previously mentioned key location
Does not request deletion of all memories
